pages.text: $(bold)Voice of Cosmic Order$() (default trait of Gheloth Remains)$(br2)Effect: $(bold)on hit$(), applies $(bold)Slowness$() and $(bold)Blindness$(), with the duration growing longer as the trait level rises.$(br2)Slowness greatly reduces the target's movement and attack speed, while Blindness veils its sight — a powerful suppression-type control.
